messages.author: 7f210a55081a4056
messages.subject: LUX analysis
parts:
Hi,

I'm using data from GT3X and I read that GGIR was able to extract LUX estimates. Unfortunately, I didnt find the option to produce this analysis and the lux variables are not in the output files. Could you help me sort this out please? 
Thanks

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] LUX analysis
parts:
Hi Olivier,

GGIR uses R package read.gt3x for reading the .gt3x data and as far as I know it cannot extract temperature data. However, I suppose the package can be enhanced to derive this information. However, this then would require sponsorship/funding to pay for the work or a volunteer willing to do the work for free. Let me know if you see opportunities.

Thanks,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
